lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are arranged in approximately vertical columns and horizontal rows, forming a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with horizontal clusters of high-luminance blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial frequency observed toward the posterior and basal regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank; presence of commensal organisms (remoras) near the pelvic and caudal regions.
